Subject: RE: Proposed redlines for pilot - need decision on indemnity, warranty, discount

Marissa / Lauren — looping you in because a few of the redlines are outside standard deal desk authority and likely need exec clearance. Summary of the non-standard asks from SolarWind: 

1) Liability cap: customer requests $2M for the pilot; our standard pilot cap is $500k.
2) Indemnity: broadened mutual indemnity language including data/privacy claims; redline would create a broader customer-favoring indemnity (see attached).
3) Warranty: extension from 90 -> 180 days (affects acceptance and remediation windows).
4) Commercial: 30% pilot discount (applied to list for 3 months).

Legal viewpoint requested (cc Karthik) — my sense: 30% discount could be approved by deal desk if we offset with measurement/usage caps; warranty extension is negotiable; indemnity expansion and cap increase are higher risk.

Options I recommend for speed:
- Preferred (fastest): Offer a commercial concession (25% pilot discount) + a SOW-only indemnity carveout (limit indemnity to claims arising from SolarWind's data handling) + keep liability cap at $1M for pilot. Karthik, is that acceptable legally?
- Conservative: Hold to standard terms (500k cap, 90 days, standard mutual indemnity with limited carveouts) and offer a commercial credit instead of legal concessions.
- If customer will only accept $2M cap or uncapped indemnity, escalate to CEO sign-off.

Can you please: 
- Karthik: provide legal recommendation and redline suggestions by EOD.
- Lauren / Marissa: please indicate whether you authorize a commercial concession up to 30% or if executive approval is required.

I am holding on sending counters until we have direction. SolarWind asked to move within 72 hours.

Attachments: SolarWind_Redlines_v2.docx

Regards,

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olivia Carter <olivia.carter@solarwind.io>
Date: Fri, 19 Apr 2029 16:48:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Proposed redlines for pilot - need decision on indemnity, warranty, discount

Team — read through the attached redlines. High-level legal guidance below: 

Liability cap: We should not accept an uncapped or $2M cap for a short pilot without additional commercial offset. Proposed legal compromise: $1M cap for pilot only (time-boxed to the SOW), with an explicit limitation that any aggregate liability across products remains subject to existing master agreement caps. Anything above $1M needs exec/CEO approval due to balance-sheet risk.

Indemnity: The customer's expanded indemnity language sweeps in third-party data/privacy claims broadly. We can offer a limited, SOW-scoped indemnity for privacy claims tied to SolarWind's misuse of Redwood data (i.e., non-Redwood-caused breaches) but must resist IP and broad third-party liability indemnities. Also suggest adding a liability carveout for gross negligence and willful misconduct.

Warranty: 180 days is excessive for a pilot. Recommend 120 days as a compromise with defined acceptance tests in the SOW.

Discount: Commercially 25% for the pilot is reasonable if we secure usage or term commitments (e.g., conversion target or short renewal window).

If Sales wants to move to $2M cap or an across-the-board indemnity expansion, we must get explicit exec sign-off (CEO-level) and a formal risk memo. Otherwise, legal can prepare a redline that implements: cap $1M (pilot-only), SOW-scoped indemnity, warranty 120 days, 25% discount tied to conversion milestone. I attached a short excerpt with suggested indemnity language (redline-excerpt-indemnity.pdf).

Happy to draft the redline and let Sales present — advise on which commercial trade-offs you want and I will produce the returned redline.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Legal, Redwood Inference

Thanks Rishi / Karthik — I reviewed Karthik's recommendation and I agree with the proposed compromise. Executive position (approved by me as CRO):

- Approve pilot liability cap at $1,000,000 (pilot-only, expire at SOW end).
- Accept SOW-scoped indemnity language as per Karthik's excerpt; no expansion to broad third-party IP indemnity.
- Approve warranty at 120 days (with clear acceptance criteria in SOW).
- Approve commercial concession up to 25% pilot discount conditional on a conversion target (convert to paid contract within 90 days of pilot completion or minimum committed usage).

Rishi: please send the Karthik redline back to SolarWind with these concessions and the conditional commercial offset. Mark any remaining items that would require CEO sign-off (i.e., cap > $1M or uncapped indemnity) and I will escalate immediately if SolarWind pushes.
